name: com.vinh.antigravity-unity-bridge
description: Editor-only bridge connecting Antigravity IDE to Unity 6: native External Script Editor (.csproj/.sln generation), read-only Scene/Hierarchy/SerializedObject/Console/Test inspection, and 7 modular atomic batch executors (Scene/Prefab, uGUI + UI Toolkit, Animation, Particle/VFX, Assets/SO, PackageManager/Tools, Universal SerializedObject) with 2-layer owner approval, Undo rollback, and Operation Journal recovery.
